note: Battle feel: movement, handling and intensity. Every number is GAMEPLAY TUNING (GAME INVENTION). Read by the Unreal battle only; the sim core never reads it and nothing here reaches the campaign. Contract: protocol/schemas/battle_feel.yaml. Budgets are per platform: 'measured' null means that platform has not been measured and holds the lowest setting.

clear.note: A man at the trail whose muzzle would be in a friend raises it. A friend counts when he stands within distance_cm ahead along the line the trailed musket points and within half_width_cm of that line; the piece then goes up to pitch_deg at yaw_deg (the hand stays where the trail has it). Checked every check_seconds.

kneel.note: A man down behind cover (ducked) kneels: hips lowered, the right foot drawn back so the right knee goes toward the ground, the body leant a little forward. A procedural pose until a kneeling clip is dropped in.

reload.note: The loading drill's left hand. With the butt on the ground to ram, the musket's own left-hand spot (by the lock) is down at the knee, out of a standing man's reach, and the hand hung at his thigh. It now holds the barrel higher: the spot is slid toward the muzzle until it is ram_left_hand_height_cm above his feet, by no more than ram_left_hand_max_slide_cm.
